0.1.0.en: First release of this complete rewrite of the Divoom Pixoo 64 driver with expanded canva creation abilities.

0.1.5.en: Added brightness control and made Clear Screen respect Hold Display.

0.1.6.en: Added support for newer Pixoo64 devices using the local API on port 9000.

0.1.7.en: Improved Pixoo64 pairing and discovery reliability for newer API revisions.

0.1.8.en: Added a Flow condition to check the currently selected Pixoo64 channel.

0.1.9.en: Raised the animated GIF frame cap to 60 frames to match the Pixoo64 firmware limit.

0.1.11.en: Added a Flow card to choose the animated sprite composition mode.

0.1.12.en: Added device controls to view and switch the current Pixoo64 channel.

0.2.0.en: Added a Flow condition for the current Pixoo64 channel, raised animated GIF output to the 60-frame firmware limit, added a Flow card to choose the animated sprite composition mode, and added icon-based device controls to view and switch channels.

0.2.1.en: Added automatic IP recovery when a paired Pixoo64 changes its local address. New devices are named without their IP address.
